userIntent: A light design system which will suit what we are building — a hardware design IDE where users describe what they want to build in natural language and AI generates real design artifacts (STL, DXF, PCB layouts).

themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Hermes selected for its warm ivory (#fcf7f1) + pure black palette, ideal for a light IDE.

Added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.04em to heading CSS vars; validated all fonts against Google Fonts CDN — removed VideoJS base64 icon font, replaced woff2 src blocks with Google Fonts CDN imports for Manrope, EB Garamond, and Overpass Mono.
Scaled all numeric duration values by 0.65× for snappier, engineering-tool-appropriate timing. Simplified to essential keyframes relevant to a marketing landing page.
Expanded container maxWidth to 100vw for full-bleed IDE layout; shifted bp-992px breakpoint to min-width:900px; updated visual layout descriptions to reflect split-pane IDE conventions.
Compressed all numeric spacing values by ×0.8 for tighter, IDE-appropriate density.
Enhanced focus states with 2px outline + 1px offset; changed input from bottom-only to full border for IDE clarity; added cards hover with translate and navigation underline interaction states.
Slimmed nav height from 50px to 44px; added letterSpacing 0.03em to nav typography for refined technical clarity; updated characterDescription for hardware IDE context.

Rewrote concept_by_image.md for hardware design IDE context with material shift twist (engineering paper, drafting table texture); generated original concept_by_video.md with IDE-appropriate motion direction including 3 video placements.

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — navText #000000 vs navBackground transparent (#fcf7f1): brightness 0 vs 248, high contrast. bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #fcf7f1: high contrast.
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — primary motion duration 0.195s, hover transitions 0.098-0.15s, ratio ~1.3-2x, well within 5x threshold.
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav typography has no explicit fontFamily, inherits from parent (Manrope via body styles).
